preserves the original gzip object as immutable evidence and quarantines it by its source digest; no repair path truncates, overwrites, recompresses, deletes, or renames the original archive

the deterministic outbox recovery test proves exactly-once behavior across crash/restart and does not consume, drop, duplicate, reorder, fabricate, or silently change task, dependency, actor, timestamp, event type, or audit payload
